title: App-preview config resolver (PROJECT.md preview block + package.json inference)
description: BETA-TEST GOAL (goal-app-preview), part 1 of 5. A resolver that determines HOW to start/locate the project app for the console preview. Reads an optional preview block from PROJECT.md (preview_command, preview_url or preview_port, optional preview_mode web|process); if absent, infers from package.json scripts (precedence dev > start > serve) plus a port heuristic. Returns a normalized config. Backward-compatible: no config AND no inferable script => mode none (console shows a configure hint). Built on beta; first ticket of the app-preview goal to dogfood-drive via /agentic-framework-beta:loop.
acceptance_criteria: New module src/preview-resolver.js exports resolvePreviewConfig({repoRoot}) returning { mode (enum web|process|none), command (string|null), cwd, url (string|null), source (configured|inferred|none) }.

Configured path: an optional preview block in PROJECT.md frontmatter (preview_command + preview_url or preview_port + optional preview_mode) is parsed and TAKES PRECEDENCE over inference; preview_mode defaults to web when a url/port is present, else process.
Inference fallback: with no preview config, infer command from package.json scripts in precedence dev > start > serve; mode web if a port/url can be derived else process; source=inferred.
No config and no usable script => { mode: none, source: none } with no throw.
state/PROJECT.schema.json extended with the OPTIONAL preview fields; existing PROJECT.md files remain valid (backward-compatible).
tdd: failing tests first encoding precedence (configured > inferred > none), mode derivation, and backward-compat; pure-logic specs at tests/ top level, any disk-fixture reads under tests/e2e/.
Schema change => release-tier gate: npm run test:all green; rebuild dist via npm run build:plugin and commit if any bundled source changes.
